skill.name: imagegen
skill.description: Generate AI images from text prompts through the verging.ai proxy API using DALL-E 3 or gpt-image-1.
skill.summary: Generate text-to-image requests through the verging.ai proxy API with model, quality, count, and CDN response guidance.
skill.author: verging-ai

security_audit.summary: The skill is documentation-only Markdown with no executable scripts, but it intentionally uses the external verging.ai API and CDN. API key examples are placeholders, and Markdown backticks caused false positives for shell execution. No prompt injection or covert exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Document how verging.ai handles prompts, generated images, CDN hosting, retention, and billing before users send requests.
Keep using placeholders and add guidance to store API keys in a local secret manager or environment variable.
Label the curl block as a manual example so agents do not run it without explicit user approval.

content.value_statement: Creating image API calls by hand can slow visual prototyping. This skill documents the verging.ai image endpoint, request options, costs, and response fields.
actual_capabilities: Documents how to call the verging.ai image generation endpoint.
Shows the required Authorization header and API key placeholder format.
Lists prompt, model, size, quality, and image count parameters.
Explains standard and HD credit costs per generated image.
Describes successful responses with CDN image URLs and credit usage.
Summarizes common API error responses for invalid requests, credits, rate limits, and upstream failures.
limitations: Requires a verging.ai account and API key before use.
Sends prompts and request metadata to the verging.ai service.
Only documents 1024x1024 default image generation behavior.
Generated image availability depends on external API and CDN uptime.

use_cases.title: Prototype Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Create prompt-driven image requests for product concepts, mood boards, or early campaign visuals.

use_cases.title: Generate App Placeholders
use_cases.description: Request sample images for mockups, demos, and test content without building a custom image pipeline.

use_cases.title: Plan Image API Costs
use_cases.description: Compare standard and HD generation costs before requesting multiple images from the API.

prompt_templates.title: Generate One Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate one standard quality image of a clean desk setup for a productivity app hero image.

prompt_templates.title: Create Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate three image variations for a modern fintech dashboard concept. Use HD quality and keep the style professional.

prompt_templates.title: Specify Model and Parameters
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with explicit API options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gpt-image-1 to generate two 1024x1024 HD images of a sustainable delivery service concept. Include the expected credit cost.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Production Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with privacy and cost checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a verging.ai image generation request for four campaign images, review prompt privacy concerns, and estimate credits before sending.

output_examples.input: Generate one HD image of a futuristic city skyline at sunset.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a verging.ai image request and returns a CDN-hosted image link with the credits consumed.

output_examples.input: Create three standard quality product mockup backgrounds for a mobile app launch.
output_examples.output: The result includes three generated image links and a credit total based on the standard quality rate.

output_examples.input: Estimate the cost for four HD image generations before sending the request.
output_examples.output: The skill calculates the expected credit use and prompts for confirmation before the API call.

best_practices: Use clear prompts that describe subject, style, composition, and intended use.
Confirm credit cost before requesting multiple HD images.
Avoid sending confidential text, customer data, or unreleased product details in prompts.
anti_patterns: Do not place real API keys directly in prompts, tickets, or shared documents.
Do not generate multiple HD images without checking available credits.
Do not treat CDN image URLs as private storage for sensitive work.

faq.question: What service does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the verging.ai proxy API for DALL-E 3 or gpt-image-1 image generation.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Users need a verging.ai API key in the Authorization header.

faq.question: How many images can it request at once?
faq.answer: The documented n parameter supports one to four images per request.

faq.question: What image quality options are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents standard and HD quality modes.

faq.question: Where are generated images returned?
faq.answer: Successful responses include CDN-hosted image URLs and the credits consumed.

faq.question: Can it work without network access?
faq.answer: No. It depends on the external verging.ai API and CDN.
